app.signin.title.description: Sign-in page: its title (signing in to a Stremio account).

app.signin.copy.value: Scan the code with your phone, or enter it at link.stremio.com. Or use email and password.
app.signin.copy.description: Sign-in page: the explanation under the title; the QR code and its code follow below it.

app.signin.with_email.description: Sign-in page: heading of the section with the email and password fields.

app.signin.email.description: Sign-in page: label of the email field.

app.signin.password.description: Sign-in page: label of the password field.

app.signin.not_entered.description: Sign-in page: the dim value of a text field nothing has been typed into yet.

app.signin.submit.description: Sign-in page: the button that signs in with the typed email and password.

app.signin.working.description: Sign-in page: note while a sign-in is in progress.

app.signin.rejected.description: Sign-in page: the account service refused the sign-in; {reason} is its own message (e.g. a wrong password).

app.signin.offline.value: Couldn’t reach Stremio ({reason}). Check that the TV is online.
app.signin.offline.description: Sign-in page: the sign-in got no answer; {reason} is the technical cause. A retry button follows.

app.signin.retry.description: Sign-in page: the button that repeats a sign-in or code request that failed.

app.signin.with_phone.description: Sign-in page: heading of the section about signing in by confirming a code on a phone.

app.signin.link_start.description: Sign-in page: the button that asks for a code to confirm on a phone.

app.signin.link_creating.description: Sign-in page: note while a sign-in code is being requested.

app.signin.link_waiting.value: Waiting for you to confirm the code on your phone…
app.signin.link_waiting.description: Sign-in page: note while the shown code waits to be confirmed on a phone.

app.signin.link_failed.description: Sign-in page: the code request failed; {reason} is the technical cause.

app.signin.link_expired.description: Sign-in page: the shown code was not confirmed in time.

app.signin.link_new.description: Sign-in page: the button that replaces an expired code.

app.signin.without.description: Sign-in page: heading of the section that skips signing in.

app.signin.skip.description: Sign-in page: the button that goes on without an account.

app.signin.skip_detail.description: Sign-in page: under the skip button; signed out, only the Cinemeta addon is used.

app.addons.title.description: Addons page: its title (the Stremio addons the app uses).

app.addons.copy_signed_in.value: Your Stremio account’s addons, in order. Install or remove them in Stremio on another device.
app.addons.copy_signed_in.description: Addons page, signed in: the explanation under the title.

app.addons.copy_signed_out.value: Signed out: Cinemeta only. Sign in to use your account’s addons.
app.addons.copy_signed_out.description: Addons page, signed out: the explanation under the title.

app.addons.account.description: Addons page: heading of the account section.

app.addons.restoring.description: Addons page: note while the saved session is being read.

app.addons.sign_in.description: Addons page and Library: the button that opens the sign-in page.

app.addons.sign_in_detail.value: Use the addons and library of your account
app.addons.sign_in_detail.description: Addons page: under the sign-in button.

app.addons.signed_in.description: Addons page: label of the row showing the signed-in account's email.

app.addons.refreshing.description: Addons page: note while the account's addon list is being fetched.

app.addons.refresh_failed.description: Addons page: the account's addon list could not be fetched; {reason} is the cause. The last known list stays.

app.addons.not_kept.value: This TV couldn’t save the sign-in. You will need to sign in again next time.
app.addons.not_kept.description: Addons page: the session could not be stored on the TV.

app.addons.sign_out.description: Addons page: the button that signs out of the account.

app.addons.installed.description: Addons page: heading of the list of addons.

app.addons.configurable.description: Addons page: an addon whose settings can be changed (in Stremio).

app.addons.res_catalog.description: Addons page: what an addon serves — catalogs of titles.

app.addons.res_meta.description: Addons page: what an addon serves — details of titles (descriptions, episodes).

app.addons.res_stream.description: Addons page: what an addon serves — streams to play.

app.addons.res_subtitles.description: Addons page: what an addon serves — subtitles.

app.addons.res_addon_catalog.description: Addons page: what an addon serves — lists of other addons.

app.addons.about.description: One addon's page: heading of its facts.

app.addons.version.description: One addon's page: label of its version.

app.addons.serves.description: One addon's page: label of what it serves (catalogs, streams…) and for which types.

app.addons.yes.description: One addon's page: a yes value.

app.addons.no.description: One addon's page: a no value.

app.addons.search.description: One addon's page: heading of its search setting.

app.addons.search_toggle.description: One addon's page: switch that decides whether a search asks this addon.

app.addons.no_search.description: One addon's page: the addon has no searchable catalog.

app.addons.catalogs.description: One addon's page: heading of its catalog list.

app.addons.no_catalogs.description: One addon's page: the addon lists no catalog.

app.addons.on_home.description: One addon's page: a catalog shown as a row on Home.

app.addons.search_only.description: One addon's page: a catalog that is only used by search.

app.addons.gone.value: This addon is no longer in use.
app.addons.gone.description: One addon's page: the addon was removed from the account.

app.home.continue.description: Home: heading of the row of titles in progress.

app.library.loading.description: Library: caption beside the spinner while the library loads.

app.library.empty.description: Library: read-out when the account's library has nothing.

app.library.signed_out.value: Sign in to see your library
app.library.signed_out.description: Library, signed out: the verdict; a sign-in button follows.

app.library.signed_out_reason.value: Your library and Continue Watching come from your Stremio account.
app.library.signed_out_reason.description: Library, signed out: the line under the verdict.

app.library.count.description: Library: a type row's annotation — how many titles it holds.

app.library.none_of_type.description: Library: read-out when the type filter is set to a type the library holds nothing of. {kind} is the type's plural label (Movies, Series).

app.library.empty_hint.value: Hold OK on a title to add it to your library.
app.library.empty_hint.description: Library: the hint under the empty-library verdict, saying how to add a title.
